summary: P-07B vibration rose to 7.9 mm/s exceeding the 7.1 mm/s alarm and was taken out of service with LOTO tag #4471 applied and duty switched to P-07A. Inspection found coupling misalignment 0.32 mm (tolerance 0.05 mm) and discoloured grease; laser alignment to 0.03 mm offset and bearing regrease with 18 g per bearing were completed and a 30 min test run at 80% speed showed 2.4 mm/s vibration and 52 C bearing temperature. Work order restores P-07B to duty/standby rotation with updated VFD ramp and protection setpoints and requires 24 h vibration trend logging.

steps.instruction: Confirm LOTO tag #4471 removed by authorised technician.
Set VFD D-07B ramp-up time to 12 s.
Set vibration alarm setpoint to 7.1 mm/s.
Set vibration trip setpoint to 11.0 mm/s.
Set discharge pressure high limit to 6.2 bar.
Return P-07B to duty/standby rotation, lead pump P-07A.
Log first 24 h vibration trend and upload at next maintenance window.
